performance_case.causal_mechanism: Accepted Local Research learning is currently absent from the canonical experiment-only weekly brief. A hash-bound explicit output matrix can prevent useful mechanism and capability work from being invisible, repeated or confused with infrastructure activity, while post-commit receipt binding avoids a self-referential source identity.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This successor dispatch may validate blocked V1 and classify only the exact three frozen accepted Local closures, then design the minimum later read-only classification contract. It cannot scan other results, change canonical reporting or state, implement a tool, add a timer, inspect market outcomes, create a strategy, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. The two counted mechanism conclusions are nested historical descriptive evidence and the capability slice contains no economic ledger, so forward path risk and every matched-capital drawdown claim remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One corrected bounded matrix audit costs little and preserves V1's fail-closed learning instead of weakening its equality rule. It prevents a larger premature reporting integration and preserves research capacity for the active 14-day R2 evidence lane.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The audit itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its research value is accurate weekly learning visibility: count accepted evidence conclusions and capability slices without inflating throughput through source, infrastructure or scheduling tasks, thereby reducing duplicate work and shortening time to the next falsifiable question.
